Hi Linda —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a draft questionnaire response plus an example staged timeline and our canary runbook. High‑level summary below; the attached workbook (Redwood_Implementation_Timeline_v2.xlsx) includes week-by-week milestones and assumed customer responsibilities.

Summary (short):
- Discovery (2 weeks): kickoff, access provisioning, API contract review, schema mapping. Customer deliverables: sandbox credentials, sample payloads, list of critical flows.
- Integration / Sandbox validation (3 weeks): implement auth (mTLS or token), integrate SDKs, run validation test harness. Redwood provides a validation suite and a set of pre-built harnesses for latency/throughput profiling.
- Pilot / Canary (4 weeks): two-stage canary: 10% traffic for 2 weeks (smoke + metrics stable), 30% traffic for 1 week (traffic shaping tests), then phased ramp. Rollback criteria include any P0 errors > 0.5% or tail latency above SLO for two consecutive 1‑hour windows.
- Phased ramp (2–4 weeks): incremental production lanes (50% -> 75% -> 100%) with automated rollback policy and operator signoff gates.
- Full cutover & hypercare (2 weeks): extended monitoring, weekly business reviews, runbook handoff.

Observability & SLIs:
- Primary SLIs: 95/99/99.9 latency quantiles, token/sec throughput, error rate (4xx/5xx by class), model-quality regression checks (task-specific evals).
- Alerts: SRE and customer oncall paged for P0/P1; automated rollback for severe degradation.
- Logs & retention: request/response storage configurable per deployment: Hosted (default 30 days), Dedicated (customer-configurable), Private (customer-managed; we recommend 180 days for audit purposes).

Security & data handling: Redwood Private deployment (VPC) or Private on‑prem package for regulated workloads. We support customer-owned KMS, audit logs (immutable) export to customer SIEM, and limited artifact retention. See canary-runbook.pdf for data masking guidance during post‑pilot logs review.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_Implementation_Timeline_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, week-by-week milestones)
- canary-runbook.pdf (runbook: traffic-split procedures, monitoring dashboards, rollback gates)

We can convert the workbook into your preferred template and go through the items in a 60‑minute workshop. I have availability Mon 24th (16:00–18:00 UTC) and Tue 25th (09:00–12:00 UTC). Which works for your team?

Thanks — happy to tighten the technical sections after we sync with your integration lead.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
